title: CWP/23576/2025 of KRISHAN ALIAS KRISHAN KUMAR Vs STATE OF HARYANA AND ORS
text:
` IN THE HIGH COURT OF PUNJAB AND HARYANA AT CHANDIGARH 114 CWP-23576-2025 Date of Decision: 26.08.2025 Krishan alias Krishan Kumar …Petitioner Versus State of Haryana and others …Respondents CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE JAGMOHAN BANSAL Present: - Mr. Nafeesh Ahmed, Advocate for the petitioner Mr. Ashok Kumar Khubbar, Additional Advocate General, Haryana (assisted by Ms. Seema Chauhan, ADA, Home Guard) JAGMOHAN BANSAL, J. (Oral)

1. The petitioner through instant petition under Articles 226/227 of the Constitution of India is seeking direction to respondents to reinstate him on the post of Home Guard with consequential benefits.

2. The petitioner joined Haryana Home Guards on 30.04.2005. He was implicated in FIR No.377 dated 09.09.2023 under Sections 420 & 406 of Indian Penal Code, 1860, registered at Police Station Tehsil Camp District Panipat. He was arrested on 05.01.2024 and thereafter, released on regular bail on 08.02.2024. The respondent discharged/relieved him in September’ 2023. He after his release on bail made representations to respondent to reengage him but to no avail. He served legal notice dated 05.05.2025 upon the respondent seeking reinstatement. authenticity of this order/judgment. `

3. Learned State counsel, on instructions from Ms. Seema Chauhan, ADA, Home Guard, submits that it is factually correct that petitioner has been disengaged, however, no formal discharge order has been passed. It is also factually correct that petitioner worked with respondent from 2005 to 2023.

4. On being asked, learned State counsel submits that competent authority would pass an appropriate order within one month from today with respect to status of the petitioner.

5. In the backdrop, the petition stands disposed of with a direction to respondent to pass an appropriate order with respect to status of the petitioner, after granting him an opportunity of hearing. (JAGMOHAN BANSAL) JUDGE 26.08.2025 Mohit Kumar authenticity of this order/judgment.
